Title: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using Global Secure Access (GSA)

User impact: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using GSA.

More info: Impacted services may include, but aren't limited to:

- Outlook
- Outlook on the web
- OneDrive
- SharePoint Online
- Microsoft Teams
- Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the source of the issue and establish a fix.

Scope of impact: Some users in Germany and the United Kingdom attempting to access Microsoft 365 services listed in the More info section using GSA may be impacted.

Next update by: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 11:30 AM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using Global Secure Access (GSA)

- Outlook
- Outlook on the web

Title: Users may be unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using Global Secure Access (GSA)

User impact: Users may have been unable to access multiple Microsoft 365 services using GSA.

More info: Impacted services may have included, but not been limited to:
- Outlook
- Outlook on the web
- OneDrive
- SharePoint Online
- Microsoft Teams
- Windows 365 Cloud PCs

Final status: We've completed our restarts throughout the affected infrastructure and confirmed through telemetry and user reports that this issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: Some users in Germany that attempted to access Microsoft 365 services listed in the More info section using GSA may have been impacted.

Start time: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 7:40 AM UTC

End time: Tuesday, October 13, 2026, at 6:31 PM UTC

Root cause: A section of GSA infrastructure was performing below acceptable performance thresholds, affecting connectivity to Microsoft 365 services and resulting in impact.

Next steps: 
- To help prevent similar impact in the future, we're further reviewing the GSA infrastructure and testing performance on the previously impacted portions of infrastructure.

We'll provide a preliminary Post-Incident Report within two business days and a final Post-Incident Report within five business days.
